methods.title: InCharacter: Evaluating Personality Fidelity in Role-Playing Agents through Psychological Interviews
methods.adopted_element: Use open-ended interviews and human-perceived target profiles instead of treating direct self-report answers as sufficient personality evidence.
methods.not_claimed: The paper's reported character-level accuracy is not reused as an UruhaBrain score or success threshold.

methods.title: CharacterEval: A Chinese Benchmark for Role-Playing Conversational Agent Evaluation
methods.adopted_element: Keep conversational quality, character consistency, role-play quality, and personality-related evidence as separate dimensions with human calibration.
methods.not_claimed: Its Chinese fictional-character dataset is not treated as a direct benchmark for a Japanese public persona.

methods.title: PersonaGym: Evaluating Persona Agents and LLMs
methods.adopted_element: Test persona behavior in dynamic, persona-relevant environments across expected action, justification, linguistic habits, consistency, and control tasks.
methods.not_claimed: PersonaScore is not used as a sole automatic judge and no benchmark answer is copied into the system.

methods.title: EmoCharacter: Evaluating the Emotional Fidelity of Role-Playing Agents in Dialogues
methods.adopted_element: Evaluate emotional response fidelity separately in single-turn and multi-turn contexts because general capability does not guarantee emotional fidelity.
methods.not_claimed: Its source dialogues or labels are not imported and emotional fidelity is not equated with complete persona fidelity.

methods.title: Addressing Topic Leakage in Cross-Topic Evaluation for Authorship Verification
methods.adopted_element: Report same-topic and cross-topic verification separately and construct heterogeneous topic controls so topic words cannot masquerade as speaker style.
methods.not_claimed: Authorship verification is supporting language evidence, not proof of identity or complete persona reproduction.

evidence_boundary: This registry records methodological provenance only. It does not import paper datasets, scoring models, copyrighted dialogue, target answers, or official certification.
